wind.label: steady breeze with gusts
wind.level_note: Outside sound pressure at the SuperCam microphone (2.1 m above ground), 10-300 Hz after filtering, dB re 20 uPa. Lxx are percentiles of 1 s levels (L10 exceeded 10 % of the time). pa_per_full_scale converts a decoded sample (1.0 = full scale) to pascals.

source.units: Pa (SuperCam EDR/RDR SIS JPL D-99966 v5.0, sec. 5.1.6, 5.4.2)
source.note: first SuperCam wind recording, mast deployed

processing: mean removed
notch 195.3 Hz Q30 (rover/instrument line)
low-pass 300 Hz Butterworth 4th order zero-phase (Maurice et al. 2022: wind audible to ~300 Hz)
high-pass 10 Hz Butterworth 2nd order zero-phase (design choice)
loop: last 3 s crossfaded into the start, equal power
resampled to 48 kHz
0.1 s of wrap-around added at each end; loop between loop_start_s and loop_end_s
peak normalised to -1 dBFS, scale stored in pa_per_full_scale
Opus 32k
